# CrawfisSoftware.Tiling llms.txt
Concise map for LLMs: core 2D tiling library (Wang-style edges, maze/dungeon/path rendering) targeting `netstandard2.1`, packaged for NuGet and Unity (Packages/com.crawfissoftware.tiling). Favor existing abstractions and keep C# idioms minimal.

Extensibility: This base package is designed to pair with additional tile sets (e.g., maze variants) and Unity-focused explicit tile sets/renderers. New tile sets, selectors, builders, and enumerators can be added by implementing the interfaces below; traversal and selection strategies are intentionally pluggable.

## Primary documentation
- [README](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/README.md): Overview, usage, packaging, and release details.

## Core interfaces (preferred entry points)
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITile2D.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITile2D.cs): Tile edge colors/IDs contract.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/Tile2D.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/Tile2D.cs): Basic tile implementation backing `ITile2D`.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/Tiling2DIndex.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/Tiling2DIndex.cs): Index/value struct used across tilings.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITiling2D.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITiling2D.cs): 2D tiling container API.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITileSet.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITileSet.cs): Tile set abstraction (lookup by edge colors).
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITileSelector.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITileSelector.cs): Strategy interface for picking tiles.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITilingEnumerator.cs): Traversal order contract for tilings.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITilingBuilder.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/ITilingBuilder.cs): Builder interface for composing tilings.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/TilingUtility.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Interfaces/TilingUtility.cs): Shared helpers for tiling implementations.

## Core implementations
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSet.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSet.cs) / [CompositeTileSet.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/CompositeTileSet.cs): Tile set implementations and composition support.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileDatabase.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileDatabase.cs): Registry/persistence for tile sets.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileFactory.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileFactory.cs) and [TileSetFactory.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetFactory.cs): Creation utilities for tiles and sets.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetUtilities.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetUtilities.cs) and [TileSearchUtility.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSearchUtility.cs): Helpers for querying and transforming tile sets.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetSelection.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetSelection.cs) and [TileSetInfo.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/TileSetInfo.cs): Metadata and selection descriptors.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/AbstractPartialTileSet.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/AbstractPartialTileSet.cs) and [AbstractMazeTileSet.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSets/AbstractMazeTileSet.cs): Extension points for partial/maze-oriented sets.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TilingBuilders/TilingBuilder.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingBuilders/TilingBuilder.cs), [MatchingTilingBuilder.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingBuilders/MatchingTilingBuilder.cs), [RandomTilingBuilder.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingBuilders/RandomTilingBuilder.cs): Implementations of `ITilingBuilder` strategies.
- [src/Common/Runtime/TileSelectors/RandomTileSelector.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSelectors/RandomTileSelector.cs) and [SequentialTileSelector.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TileSelectors/SequentialTileSelector.cs): Implementations of `ITileSelector`.

## Tiling enumerators (traversal strategies)
- [SequentialTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/SequentialTilingEnumerator.cs), [RandomTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/RandomTilingEnumerator.cs), [ZOrderTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/ZOrderTilingEnumerator.cs), [ZigzagTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/ZigzagTilingEnumerator.cs): Canonical traversal orders.
- [SpiralTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/SpiralTilingEnumerator.cs), [HilbertTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/HilbertTilingEnumerator.cs), [CornerTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/CornerTilingEnumerator.cs), [UpperLeftQuadrantEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/UpperLeftQuadrantEnumerator.cs): Patterned traversals.
- [BoundaryTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/BoundaryTilingEnumerator.cs), [RectangleTilingEnumeratorDecorator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/RectangleTilingEnumeratorDecorator.cs), [MaskedTilingEnumeratorDecorator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/MaskedTilingEnumeratorDecorator.cs): Region-aware traversal decorators.
- [ExplicitTilingEnumerator.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/TilingEnumerators/ExplicitTilingEnumerator.cs): Iterator over explicit coordinate lists.

## Utilities
- [src/Common/Runtime/Utility/ExplicitTiling2D.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Utility/ExplicitTiling2D.cs): Concrete `ITiling2D` built from explicit tile entries.
- [src/Common/Runtime/Utility/TilingRemapper.cs](https://github.com/Crawfis-Software/CrawfisSoftware.Tiling/blob/master/src/Common/Runtime/Utility/TilingRemapper.cs): Remaps tilings via ID transformations.

## Notes for LLMs
- Enumerators and tile sets are intentionally extensible; additional traversal orders and tile libraries (including Unity-focused sets/renderers) can be added via the interfaces above.
